3.1.0: 🚀 **New Settings Panel:** Completely redesigned Settings tab with cloud backup & restore, one-time announcement popups, and a Location Fix wizard that validates your State/District against server records.
🚀 **New Automation (Pending Bills):** Added the Pending Bills automation tab to track and process pending bills efficiently.
💬 **WhatsApp Integration:** Send files and messages directly to WhatsApp (Evolution API) with a dedicated WhatsApp chat tab.
📍 **Auto-Fetch Locations:** State/District/Block now auto-fetch from the server with a filtered location hierarchy — no more manual spelling errors.
☁️ **Cloud Sync:** User data & settings now sync to your account — activate on any PC or restore after factory reset in one click.
🔐 **Security Fix:** License key is no longer exposed in URLs.
🏠 **Home Page Fix:** Blocked/premium tabs can no longer be opened from the Home page shortcuts.
🌐 **Browser Launch:** Default launch URLs are now centralized in config — added vbgramg.nregabot.com at startup.
🖥️ **UI Overhaul:** Improved layouts across all automation tabs; dashboard & issued-report fixes; standardized logs and status output.
📊 **Report Fixes:** MIS reports fixed and Excel result output standardized.
⚡ **All Villages Option:** Added 'All Villages' support in multiple automation tabs for faster bulk processing.
🔄 **Beta Builds:** Added beta portable build support with auto-update bypass for testing.
🐞 **Bug Fixes:** Overhaul of the whole app — dozens of stability and reliability fixes.
3.0.7: 🧹 **Repository Cleanup:** Removed unnecessary backup files and screenshots from the repository to reduce release size.
📦 **Optimized Release:** Fixed release pipeline to exclude old backups and screenshots from the build artifacts.
3.0.6: 🚀 **Delete Applicant Overhaul:** Complete rewrite of the Delete Applicant automation. Now accepts eKYC Report Excel files directly — no more CSV uploads.
🚀 **MB Entry Auto-Process All Works:** When no work codes are provided, MB Entry now processes ALL available works from the 'Select Work' dropdown one by one.
3.0.5: 🐞 **Critical Fix (Physical Complete):** Fixed the Physical Complete automation pointing to the wrong portal URL (nregade4.dord.gov.in). It now correctly uses the VB-G-RAM-G portal (vbgramgde2.dord.gov.in), consistent with all other automations.
3.0.4: 🐞 **Critical Fix (Mate/Mistri MR Generation):** Fixed the Mate/Mistri MR generation automation that was not working. The portal interaction flow has been corrected for reliable muster roll generation.
🐞 **Critical Fix (NMMS Attendance):** Fixed the NMMS Daily Attendance automation that was failing to complete. Resolved navigation and scraping issues causing the process to stop midway.
3.0.3: 🚀 **New Feature (NMMS Daily Attendance):** Added a brand-new 'NMMS Attendance' tab under Reports. Automatically scrapes daily attendance data from the NMMS portal — including MR details, worker list, group photos, timestamps, and geo-coordinates.
📊 **NMMS Professional Excel Report:** Generates a multi-sheet Excel report with MR Summary, Workers Detail, and Block Overview — complete with header styling, zebra striping, and auto-sized columns.
📷 **NMMS Group Photo Download:** Automatically downloads Group Photo-1 and Photo-2 for each muster roll by clicking the 'large image' link on the portal. Photos are saved to a dated folder.
🔍 **NMMS Smart Scraping:** Scrapes the current browser page for panchayat list — no URL navigation needed. The portal is accessed entirely through browser clicks to avoid 'Access Denied' errors.
☑️ **NMMS Select All Panchayats:** Added a prominent 'Select All' button alongside 'Clear All' to instantly select or deselect all panchayats before starting.
🗑️ **NMMS Removed 'Open NMMS Page' Button:** The direct URL navigation button has been removed. Users now open the portal manually in their browser and navigate to the panchayat list before scraping.
📜 **NMMS Full Scroll Layout:** The entire NMMS tab is now wrapped in a scrollable frame so that reports, summary tables, and logs are always accessible regardless of window size.

🐞 **NMMS Fix — Header Row Skipped:** Fixed the '1 2 3 4 5' column-number row appearing in Block Overview and MR list. Rows where the panchayat or work code field is a plain digit are now filtered out.

🐞 **NMMS Fix — Timestamp Parsing:** Fixed Taken, Uploaded, Geo Co-ordinates, Taken By, and Designation not appearing in the Excel report. The previous parser was misidentifying timestamp colons (e.g. 09:00:47) as label separators. Replaced with a whitelist-based label parser that correctly handles multi-line cell text.

🐞 **NMMS Fix — Navigation:** Fixed browser navigation to use click-based flow throughout (no driver.get URL calls). Back button is used to return between pages, preventing 'Access Denied' on the government portal.
3.0.2: 🌐 **VB-G-RAM-G Portal Support:** NREGA Bot is now fully compatible with the new government portal — VB-G-RAM-G (vbgramgde2.dord.gov.in). All automations continue to work seamlessly on the renamed portal.
🔄 **Portal Name Updated:** All in-app references, labels, and messages now correctly display 'VB-G-RAM-G portal' instead of the old name, so users always know which portal is being accessed.
ℹ️ **Onboarding Updated:** The setup guide now directs users to log in to the VB-G-RAM-G portal for a clearer first-time experience.

🐞 **Critical Fix (MR & Duplicate MR Print):** Fixed the extra blank page appearing at the end of PDFs generated in Chrome. Footer is now injected via JavaScript instead of using Chrome's CDP header/footer template, which was causing the blank page.

🐞 **Critical Fix (Delete Demand):** Fixed the automation getting stuck while waiting for the village dropdown to load after selecting a Panchayat. Replaced the old unreliable `staleness_of(body)` wait with a fast-polling check that confirms the village list is populated.

🗑️ **Delete Demand Smart Skip:** The bot now reads the portal's 'no data' or 'already deleted' message and skips the village instantly instead of timing out, making bulk deletion significantly faster.
✨ **Demand Tab UI Overhaul:** Completely redesigned applicant selection area. The entire settings panel is now scrollable so no content is ever hidden on small screens.

⚡ **Quick-Select JC Bar (Demand):** Added a new 'Quick Select' input bar — type multiple Job Card suffixes (e.g. 1/5, 12/44) and press Enter to instantly select them without scrolling through the full list.
🎨 **Demand Tab Layout:** Select All and Clear buttons are now always visible alongside the file upload buttons. Search box is integrated into the quick-select bar for a cleaner layout.
🔗 **MR Tracking URL Updated:** MR Tracking report now points to the new VB-G-RAM-G reporting portal (vbgramgrep.dord.gov.in) for up-to-date muster roll status.

⚡ **Auto-Forward to Scheme Closing:** After successful physical completion, work codes are automatically forwarded to the Scheme Closing tab for seamless workflow.
🔄 **Batch Processing:** Supports bulk processing of multiple work codes with real-time success/failure tracking and detailed logs.
📊 **Export Results:** Export Physical Complete results to PDF or CSV directly from the Results tab.
🕵️ **MR Tracking Update:** Updated MR Tracking URL to financial year 2026-2027 with latest digest.

💾 **Material Profiles:** Save and load material sets (name, rate, qty, GST) as named profiles for instant reuse.
📊 **Live Totals:** Real-time Amount, GST, and Grand Total calculation updates as you type.
📤 **Export Results:** Export Material Entry results to CSV directly from the Results tab.
🔄 **Scroll Support:** Added horizontal and vertical scrollbars to Work Key input, Results, and Logs areas.
🐞 **Critical Fix (Material Entry):** Resolved 'Stale Element' errors on Work Category and Work Code dropdown after page postbacks.
🐞 **Critical Fix (Material Entry):** Fixed Work Code not found issue caused by insufficient postback wait time after TAB key.
🐞 **Critical Fix (Material Entry):** Vendor dropdown now re-fetched fresh after postback to prevent stale reference errors.
